One process, any organization

Every job runs in five steps.

Step 01

Find

Mozart watches where work lands and picks up each request as it arrives.

Step 02

Prepare

Every fact is traced to the page it came from before anyone relies on it.

Step 03

Act

The work goes to the other party, once it is approved.

Step 04

Follow up

Step 05

The result is kept, along with how the other side behaved.
